Use a comma to include multiple call signs, e.g. CPA847,BA55W.
Radar codes can include a combination of letters and numbers, 5 to 10 characters A-Z, 0-9, and - (hyphen).
Radar codes can include a combination of letters and numbers, 5 to 10 characters A – Z, 0 – 9, and - (hyphen). Use a comma to enter multiple radar codes e.g. T-KJFK567,F-ESSB2.
Registration can include a combination of letters and numbers, 2 to 12 characters.

Registration can include a combination of letters and numbers, 2 to 12 characters. Use * at the beginning or end to include all possible combinations, e.g. M-* will show all flights that begin with registration M-, *HV will show all flights ending in HV. Use a comma to enter multiple registrations, e.g. D-AIHV,M-ILAN
